about.label: About
about.title: Why NAJDA exists
about.description: NAJDA simulates an emergency dispatch network end to end — not a real emergency service, and not connected to one.
about.sectionTitle: The problem we set out to model
about.sectionDescription: Real dispatch systems coordinate many independent actors — citizens, dispatchers, ambulance crews, police, firefighters, and hospitals — all working off the same incident, but each needing a different slice of it. We wanted to build that coordination for real, not fake it with a single flat dashboard.
about.sectionDescription2: Every workflow in NAJDA runs against a real backend: shift management ties a vehicle's availability to whether a crew is actually on duty for it, AI-assisted priority scoring is advisory only, and every status change is written to a persistent incident record. What isn't real is the emergency itself — nothing here dispatches an actual ambulance.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.simulationBody: NAJDA is a simulation platform and is not a real emergency service. It is not affiliated with, monitored by, or connected in any way to any government emergency response system, hospital network, or law enforcement agency. Submitting a report through this platform does not dispatch a real ambulance, fire truck, or police unit. If you are experiencing a real emergency, contact your local emergency number directly.
terms.acceptableUseBody: By creating an account, you agree to use this platform only for its intended purpose — testing and demonstrating the simulated dispatch workflow. Submitting false reports intended to disrupt testing, impersonating another person, or attempting to access accounts or data you're not authorized to view is not permitted.
terms.accountsBody: Employee and responder accounts (Dispatcher, Ambulance Crew, Police, Firefighter, First Responder, Hospital Staff, Admin) are created and managed by system administrators. Citizen accounts are self-registered. You're responsible for keeping your credentials secure.
terms.applicationsBody: Submitting an application to become a First Responder does not guarantee approval. Applications are reviewed manually by an administrator, and any documents submitted are used solely to evaluate the application.
terms.warrantyBody: This platform is provided as-is, without warranty of availability, accuracy, or fitness for any particular purpose.
terms.contactBody: Questions can be sent through the Support page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: This page explains what data we collect and how it's used.
privacy.accountInfo: Account information — name, email, phone number, address, and gender, provided at registration.
privacy.locationData: Location data — GPS coordinates or a manually placed pin, submitted when reporting an incident, and live unit positions for staff/responder accounts.
privacy.mediaData: Media — photos, video, or audio voluntarily attached to an incident report, and documents attached to a First Responder application.
privacy.usageData: Usage data — chat messages, mission history, and shift records tied to an incident or account.
privacy.usedBody1: Data is used exclusively to operate the simulated dispatch workflow: routing incident reports, coordinating responder assignments, and displaying account/incident history.
privacy.usedBody2: Incident text and category may be sent to a third-party AI service to generate a priority suggestion — this is advisory only and never made without human review.
privacy.storedBody: Account credentials are managed by Firebase Authentication. Application data is stored in a Postgres database. Uploaded media lives in a private storage bucket, accessible only via short-lived, authorization-checked links generated by our backend — never a public URL.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: Map tiles and driving directions are computed by third-party mapping services. Neither receives account information — only the coordinates needed to render a map or a route.
privacy.dontBody: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with advertisers. This project carries no advertising and no analytics beyond what's needed to operate the platform itself.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or data-deletion requests can be sent through the Support page.
